messages:
eli: Heads-up: noticed a tenant with steady KV page residency growth during long-context runs. Not a spike — linear increase across ~30m sessions. Attaching pprof snippet.

eli: pprof heap summary:
```
heap profile: 72 samples, 9.1GB total
retained_by_objects: kv_page (proto) ~4.1GB
live_objects: kv_page 48k
sampled_alloc_space: 2.6GB
```

eli: Workload: many turns with 6k-10k tokens, repeated streaming. Eviction attempts are low; pages stay resident and don't show reuse.

nina: @eli do we have tenant quota config for that host? any soft/hard threshold triggers?

eli: Soft quota is 65% of host RMem, threshold hit briefly but no hard evictions. Evictor logs show only background compaction. Host peers quiet.

mike: Could be fragmentation: lots of partial-page allocs from longctx leading to internal waste. Any compaction metrics?

jess: I pulled slab and page histograms. High number of small live segments (~27 bytes avg) in the kv_page protos. Suspect proto growth due to appended metadata per write.

rama: Do we have p99 kv reuse rate? If reuse low, residency with low churn is possible.

eli: Reuse-rate: tenant-specific KV access heatmap shows many pages cold after initial reads, <5% reuse in sliding 10m window.

nina: Oof. That matches "sticky but useless" pages. Could be our eviction scoring weights favor recency over tenant fairness. Any recent perf rollout touching eviction heuristics?

mike: Last week we tweaked spill threshold for kernel selection batching. Not directly eviction, but batching changes can alter access patterns. Filing hypothesis.

jess: Also saw increased proto size due to new trace tags (we added trace_id on writes last month). That increases per-page proto size and pushes residency.

eli: Actions proposed:
- add tenant-local debug flag to force aggressive eviction for repro
- collect per-page last_access and size over time (10s granularity)
- run controlled tenant replay on staging host

rama: +1. I'll provision a staging host and run a replay with reduced quotas to confirm.

ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-kv-sticky-residency for tracking

nina: If reproduces, we should consider short-term mitigations: bump eviction weight for tenants over XMB, or temporarily disable trace_id tagging for heavy tenants.

mike: I'll prepare a small patch to eviction scoring and a feature flag.

jess: I'll audit recent proto changes for padded fields.

eli: Thanks team. I'll attach full heap profiles and heatmaps once uploaded to the thread.

eli: Uploaded: https://internal-pprof/2312345678/heap-72.pb.gz

rama: Running replay now on staging, will post results in ~20m.

nina: Thanks — please add a quick check to automated alerts if host free-memory drifts >8% over 15m.

jess: Noted, I'll add an endpoint-level metric.

eli: Closing loop later today with findings.
